La atencion fue mala,fuimos a tomar el dasayuno con la flia por que estabamos de viaje y nos dieron un te,cafe en taza de tergopol y no nos quisieron cargar los puntos de la serviclub.La mesa sucia,el lugar muy oscuro..No he visto en otras estaciones de YPF de nuestro largo viaje en esta condiciones..Personalmente mala la experiencia

(Translated by Google)
The service was terrible. We went for breakfast with the family because we were traveling, and they gave us tea and coffee in Styrofoam cups and refused to credit our Serviclub points. The table was dirty, and the place was very dark. I haven't seen any other YPF stations on our long trip in such conditions. Personally, it was a bad experience.
